items.title: Tom Albert and Milton "Mooney" Martin Interview, 1964-12-21

ctx.x: You always know that time. No, that was before my time.

No, that's in the...about 31. Yeah, I wasn't here. Oh, yeah. Well, I was going to ask about... Take Peter. Peter had leading the Excelsior band then. Peter, leading the Excelsior band. The more onwards, the more onwards, the more onwards, cause when Manuel had left and went up there to Celestine, and him and Celestine didn't make it and he come back to...the band that's called there. Excelsior? The more now, I'll share. The more now, I'll share. And Celestine. And that's the day they had DeFune, they had Manuel…
Well we opened up, we opened up right at the graveyard you see. I believe we was behind, wasn't we? We was behind. We was the last man. And then we opened up, let them go in the graveyard.
